reviews.text: Dr. Busardo was very professional, helpful, and attentive. He demonstrated great expertise and sensitivity, explaining everything clearly and immediately putting us at ease. A serious and knowledgeable professional, at a clinic I highly recommend!

I showed up around 12:30 a.m., but no one opened.
I rang and called several times, but nothing.
After about 15 minutes, I left and went elsewhere.
They say they're open 24 hours a day, but apparently that's not the case.
If I'd known, I would have gone straight to another establishment without wasting any time.
Perhaps you should clarify that you don't provide any service at night.
Thank you so much for your feedback! We're happy you had a positive experience.

They seem good (they may be) but they "force" you to bring the various waters to their own mill (rightly so) and that is, they make you do a lot of tests, too many in my opinion (the waters I was talking about) and unfortunately they are not cheap at all 😏
The staff is welcoming and knowledgeable, but the medical director is a bit too obsessed with invoices and payments; he's not the best in front of customers...
Thank you for sharing your experience and for your trust in us! We work passionately to ensure quality care and attention for all the pets who trust us.

I've been going to Diagnostica Veteraria for years—in fact, I only go to Diagnostica Veteraria. Dr. Floris has always been my veterinarian. He's knowledgeable, professional, and humane. The entire staff is also truly knowledgeable. I highly recommend them.
Imma and Giovanna, a guarantee

Very honest people. I dropped my dog ​​off at 10:30 PM in the middle of the night after visiting a well-known emergency room in Rome. Prompt, empathetic, and compassionate.

I would like to sincerely thank the entire staff at the Veterinary Clinic on Via Roccaraso, especially oncologist Dr. Filippo Roberto Busardo, who helped us with Red 🐈, and Dr. Alberto Cerbini, who helped him die with the dignity he deserved. Thank you all! 🫶 …

Romeo, my 13-year-old cat, arrived at the emergency clinic a month ago on a Sunday morning at 6:00 a.m., bleeding from his mouth and weighing only 3.4 kg.
The clinic itself diagnosed kidney failure. Romeo was hospitalized for four days, and the recommended treatment protocol proved effective: today he weighs 4.5 kg, a result I wouldn't have hoped for so quickly.
A special thanks to Dr. Carlotta Trivelli, who was there on that difficult early morning: in addition to her great professionalism, she demonstrated a genuine love for animals. Fantastic.
Heartfelt thanks to the entire team. 🐾

Be careful if you bring your cat, in order to earn money and take your money they warned me that my cat was sick and could not have the operation, but before and after I left her she was doing very well, so various tests took €180 from me and guess what, my cat was healthier than me... I called back to make the appointment for the operation on my cat and instead of accommodating the customer they immediately insisted that I had to do another test before the operation first and last time! Profit-seeking thieves!
We are happy to know that our efforts are appreciated and that you had a positive experience with us.
Friendly and professional people!

On Saturday morning, I tried to have my dog's blood tested in preparation for cruciate ligament surgery the following week. Even though I answered their questions about the reason for the test and the type of surgery, they insisted the surgeon call them for further clarification. I had to go to another facility!

I honestly only recommend this clinic for emergencies, because for everything else, no. I took my cat there in an emergency because he was hit by a car and broke his leg. I paid €350 for the x-rays and for them to keep him there until Monday when the main veterinarian was supposed to arrive to operate. On Monday, the clinic called me saying the operation had to be done immediately and that all they needed was authorization. For this, the price of the operation increased to €3,000 from the €2,000 I was supposed to pay. When I said no, that I was looking for a way to have him operated on through a rescue organization because I didn't have enough money to pay for the surgery myself, I sensed their discomfort. I decided to ignore that and simply take my cat to this rescue organization. I requested his medical records of what they had done and given him so I could inform the organization. The response was: "The request is processed via email and takes about 10 business days." My conclusion is, how can they say my cat needs emergency surgery and then, when I decide to have him operated on elsewhere, they don't even provide me with the necessary information? the medical history immediately.
Emergency clinic open 24 hours a day, very professional, they already solved a problem some time ago, I trust them a lot and they have honest prices
We're so happy to read your review! Our team works passionately to offer the best for every pet. Thank you for sharing your experience!
We are happy to know that our efforts are appreciated and that you had a positive experience with us.

I've taken my PT there twice for MRIs, and they've consistently proven to be professional, attentive, and caring. The cost is excellent, and installment payments are available. They're excellent hands to entrust our furry children to.

After eight years of experience, the only true excellence we've encountered has been Dr. Zarielli, who has always cared for our Nina with care and compassion.

Unfortunately, we can't say the same for other professionals, especially the last veterinarian we consulted, who caused us to lose our Nina. Not even an X-ray was performed before reassuring us that it was nothing serious, despite the fact that she was a large, 8-year-old dog with excruciating abdominal pain and unproductive vomiting.

Nina died shortly thereafter from gastric torsion, at another clinic where everything possible was done to correct a superficial error that, sadly, proved fatal.

I'm also sharing a photo in the hope that this tragedy will not be forgotten and that it can at least help prevent such a grave mistake from being repeated in the future.

Thank you to Dr. Zarielli for the special care and professionalism you have shown over time.
Thank you for your positive feedback! Pet welfare and owner satisfaction are our top priorities.

I brought my dog ​​years ago and then changed due to a personality clash. I'm very sensitive, and my dog ​​is everything. After five years and a change of vet—always excellent but difficult to contact—I returned to Dr. Floris's clinic. We're treating my furry friend by elimination to avoid immediate invasive surgery, but last night I spent a sleepless night with him in pain. I called the clinic's emergency room at 4 a.m. but couldn't make an appointment with Dr. Floris without a schedule. Today I called back in tears, and the person who answered listened and comforted me, and tomorrow I have an appointment with Dr. Floris. I don't want to step over the excellent doctor who treats him, but I need a "head doctor." He may be less empathetic, but I know it now. I'll try to relate to him without a crisis, and I know he'll tell me and do the right things. We're not all the same; other doctors are very sensitive; he gets straight to the point. Ok, I accept that, as long as someone gives the correct diagnosis.

Even though we had to choose to euthanize our beautiful and loving dog, we received priceless treatment, distinguished by humanity, dignity, and professionalism from the doctor who cared for our Ayla. Thank you so much.
Your kind words truly make us happy! Our team works hard every day to provide attentive and professional service. Knowing that you appreciate our work is the best reward. Thank you for your trust!

I especially thank Dr. Trivelli for helping me with professionalism and, above all, so much empathy in dealing with the terrible moment of the death of my 17-and-a-half-year-old cat Minou.

Thank you.

I arrived at the clinic with my dying dog, Thai. I wasn't familiar with the clinic, but I must say I was very impressed. I found a level of preparation, a welcoming atmosphere, a level of care, and a level of sensitivity I certainly hadn't imagined. Clichés had led me to imagine a "money machine," but I must say that's not the case at all. Treatments certainly cost money, but nothing is offered unless absolutely necessary. Thai was hospitalized in intensive care for 10 nights, where four nurses took turns caring for her, pampering her in every way. The doctors who treated her, Dr. Ziarelli and Dr. Busardo, were always attentive and professional, never giving us false hopes, but accompanying us during these days as if she were their own dog. Thai has had three transfusions and has been out for five days now on supervised discharge because she will require long-term care. Every time she returns to the clinic, she makes everyone happy, greets everyone, and seems truly grateful. Even the secretaries have grown fond of us. There are no words to describe the peaceful atmosphere at this clinic. A sincere thank you to everyone and a big shout out to nurse Sara, who we often found in the cage with Thai!

Good morning, I hope the clinic did everything for my PJ, who had emergency surgery after an accident. Unfortunately, he was hospitalized for 10 days. 😞 He had a cardiac arrest and I hear comments that they do it to make money. I hope not. 😞 Because for us owners, they are not animals but members of the family. Very helpful staff. …

My dog ​​was dying, and they gave me the wrong tests and medications. When a friend of mine, a veterinarian, contacted them to ask for an explanation, they started changing their story and making excuses.
Professional, highly competent, and extremely kind healthcare staff. Clean, efficient, and well-equipped facility.

Excellent veterinary center. I've always turned to this center for all my needs. They're professional and highly competent. Always available and ready to address any emergency. Special thanks to Dr. Alessandro Floris, the Center's Medical Director.

I brought my cat, Pisola, in such serious condition that euthanasia seemed the only option, but thanks to the care of Dr. Floris and the other doctors, my cat is out of danger and on the road to recovery.

So, heartfelt thanks from Rita Daniele Claudio Valentina
They were able to help me and I have to thank them very much for their support.

I would like to THANK with HUGE GRATITUDE to Dr. Busardo', who for many years meticulously and selflessly cared for and looked after my dog, who sadly passed away at the age of 18 years and 6 months, despite having two serious and significant illnesses. From day one, Dr. Busardo' always stood out for his spirit of sacrifice and the passion with which he cared for my beloved dog.
I also extend my heartfelt thanks to Dr. Floris, Dr. Fantauzzo, Dr. Vinci, Dr. Fanelli, and all the staff.
A heartfelt hug from us and CLARA ❤️🌸

I took my Romeo, a poodle, to the clinic for mouth pain. I was greeted with great professionalism and kindness, very quick and helpful. The dog immediately benefited from the therapy, a daily therapy administered by them, always precise and gentle with my Romeo. I thank Dr. Alessandro Floris and all his collaborators. I highly recommend him for the health of little furry friends. Thank you ❤️

If I could, I'd give zero stars only for the owner, who's terrible. Zero empathy... the animals are just walking paper money for him. Meanwhile, the doctors are all very good and professional. Let's just say that if it weren't for them, I think the clinic would have closed its doors a long time ago.

I brought my little 15 year old puppy to this facility on August 21st because she was sick, she had a fever, basically a few problems found in the blood tests that were rightly carried out. The next day I brought her back for a check-up, she was worse than the day before so they admitted her to me, kind and professional doctors, nothing to say... After 3 days of hospitalization they discharged her because they thought she was better, I arrived home and after an hour the dog was no longer standing up, breathing heavily, body boiling, we arrived there we were welcomed, I think by the owner, I'm not entirely sure, where he continued to reiterate in a rather arrogant tone that my dog ​​was fine and that since he had been discharged an hour earlier he couldn't have a fever and much less be sick if he complained of pain it was the pains of old age, I told him that it wasn't that I was happy to be there but if the dog is sick I have to take him back, his response was that I had brought the dog there to euthanize him because I had previously seen that they told me to do test after test that they weren't necessary given the dog's age and that even if it were they wouldn't have taken her anywhere. I told them if she has to be sick and suffer I'll put her to sleep, they always told me that the dog wasn't in such a condition but I know my dog ​​and if I said something like that and because she was really sick I'm not going to do something extreme on a dog that has been with me for almost 16 years and my whole life... Oh well anyway the fact is that she is being seen again for a visit and well she had a fever of 40 she didn't have the strength to stand up let alone open her eyes, in the end today precisely because the situation having been hospitalized again and worsened I had to put her to sleep forever, and I feel bad because I miss her so much😭 anyway dear doctor in this job you need empathy the people who come there are suffering for their furry friend we are not just money that comes into the facility we are human beings if you remember that well. So many dear things.
Terrible place, terrible owner, terrible way of treating animals especially if they are hospitalized...highly not recommended!!!

Stars LESS than zero, very high prices to tell you that the dog is dead, and blackmail in the Non-restitution of the poor little body, truly despicable, there are no administrative excuses for such behavior, there is only shame, animals are not goods to fill the bank account.
Thank you for your positive feedback! Pet welfare and owner satisfaction are our top priorities.

I'm Roman but live abroad. I was in Rome for the Christmas holidays, December 26, 2024. Lenny, my little dog (a Cavalier King Charles Spaniel), had interocolitis and a lot of blood in his stool. He was treated very well. The vet, whose name I unfortunately no longer remember, was exceptional. Thanks again for everything.
Hi Sofia, we're sincerely sorry your experience wasn't positive. If you'd like, please contact us directly; we'd be happy to hear from you.

I took my dog ​​for a CT scan, and the day turned into a nightmare! Let me start by saying he's a wonderful Labrador (all vets tell me they were all like that), but the radiologist put him on the table and turned him over, traumatizing him, without any patience or empathy for a poor dog who was having a CT scan for the first time in his life. She violently restrained him, even causing him to bang his head. She made me go outside, and I heard my dog ​​crying like a slaughtered pig. After the scan, I found him covered in urine, so scared. Never again. A terrible experience.

NEVER AGAIN!!! I'll start by saying I usually avoid writing reviews, but this time I had a truly terrible experience. I took my 16-year-old cat to this clinic, handed him over to Dr. Busardò for a blood test, and he took him downstairs in his carrier. I waited, not leaving the doctor's office, and after a while I began to hear that there was blood to be cleaned, adrenaline to be injected as an anti-hemorrhagic, and comments of nervousness about the situation and my cat. I asked for an explanation, and the cat was brought back with a bandaged paw full of blood and all his nails clipped!!! WITHOUT MY CONSENT!!! The lack of suitable equipment (simple scratch-proof gloves) and, above all, patience and empathy speaks volumes!!! All this for a simple blood test, let alone if anything else were to be needed. NEVER AGAIN AT THIS CLINIC!!!
Dear Maurils, Thank you so much for your positive review! We're always here to make sure our customers are satisfied.

Dr. Ziarelli is good,
however, both from my experience and that of other dog owners here in the area, I've noticed that they have very easy admissions.
After almost 14 years, I have unfortunately encountered a lack of professionalism and attention to the patient... and to myself, perhaps at the most important moment! …
After having been to other clinics where my cat and my dog ​​had very superficial visits, I found competence and professionalism

A clinic recommended by our trusted veterinarian, Dr. Gallo, for a specialist visit, and I can say with super positive feedback! Truly, a very organized, well-maintained clinic, and above all, with great attention to cleanliness. The staff …

Let me start by saying that I'm a surgeon. This is my second time here. The first cat was euthanized without the owner asking for another box to bury it. After many warnings, I realized that it was suspicious.
It was just a simple envelope.
